description: Read this first. The capability catalog chant answers cap: terms with, for the estate behold serves: chant's read-contract capabilities document, verbatim (chant search --capabilities --json, INTENTIUS/chant#4375; chant workspace search --capabilities --json on a declared workspace). Each capability has its name, what it means, its parameters, the search term that asks it (cap:internet-reachable, ->[cap=network]), the questions it answers, what it does not evaluate, its rule, and which lexicons supply it. Then ask with that term; a cap: match's path is in its because hops, and show draws it. Uses the running behold serve of this project; with none, behold answers in this process. Takes no arguments. Needs chant 0.124.46 or newer.
name: capabilities
